country.name: Benin
country.jurisdictionNotice: Benin divides education responsibilities among the ministry responsible for maternal and primary education, the ministry responsible for secondary, technical and vocational education, and the ministry responsible for higher education and scientific research. Departmental and institutional responsibilities must remain attached to the correct subsector.
country.languagePolicy: French is the official language. National languages have distinct literacy, curriculum and community roles. A French interface or automatic translation is not reviewed localization in Fon, Yoruba, Bariba, Dendi, Ditammari or any other Beninese language.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Beninese reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible ministry, departmental authority, institution, program authority, APDP or child-protection authority.

governanceModel.summary: Maternal and primary education, secondary/technical/vocational education, and higher education are governed through separate ministries. BRASA must route each record and claim to the competent subsector authority rather than treating education as one undifferentiated register.
governanceModel.maternalPrimaryAuthority: Ministry of Maternal and Primary Education (MEMP)
governanceModel.secondaryTechnicalAuthority: Ministry of Secondary, Technical and Vocational Education (MESTFP)
governanceModel.higherEducationAuthority: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MESRS)
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve subsector, official school name or identifier, department, commune, sector, level, current status, source year and review date. Aggregate statistics, examination services and institutional counts are not a unified school directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Public-university legal status, private-establishment authorization, authorization of an exact Licence or Master program, site, modality, degree authority and quality-assurance or accreditation decision are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Maternal and Primary Education
authorities.role: maternal and primary policy, programs, statistics, examinations and administration

authorities.name: Departmental Directorates of Maternal and Primary Education
authorities.role: departmental implementation and school administration within assigned competence

authorities.name: Ministry of Secondary, Technical and Vocational Education
authorities.role: secondary general, technical, vocational, literacy and national-language subsectors

authorities.name: INIFRCF
authorities.role: development and revision of secondary and vocational study programs and training resources within its mandate

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
authorities.role: higher-education governance, public universities and official private-establishment and program information

authorities.name: Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel
authorities.role: personal-data protection authority under the Digital Code as amended

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for social affairs and child-protection actors
authorities.role: child-protection implementation under the Child Code and applicable decrees

curriculum.authority: MEMP or MESTFP according to subsector, level and program
curriculum.title: Beninese official programs and approved curriculum resources
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm competent ministry, subsector, level, class, subject or trade, official program or guide, validating instrument, version, publication date, effective school year, reform stage, department and institution. A curriculum reform announcement or service issuing an attestation of program possession is not proof that every displayed resource is the controlling current program.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: National program, teaching guide, textbook, technical reference framework, literacy material, examination syllabus, reform pilot and external resource are different layers. Materials for one subsector must not silently replace another ministry's controlling program.

schoolDirectory.authority: MEMP, MESTFP and responsible departmental directorates according to subsector
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Official ministry, EducMaster and departmental institution records
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: EducMaster publishes maternal and primary management data and department aggregates; MESTFP publishes subsector counts and institutional information. No single current public directory covering every maternal, primary, secondary, technical, vocational, public and private institution was verified. BRASA must not turn aggregates, examination verification or subsector totals into school records; each school requires an official subsector and departmental record with current status.

educationStatistics.authority: MEMP statistics directorate, MESTFP and competent national statistical authorities according to subsector
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The MEMP portal labels its headline maternal/primary values as 2026 and its detailed series as school year 2025–2026, while EducMaster displayed a different current school total during this review. Every number must preserve extract date, academic year, subsector, definition, structure coverage, public/private scope, department or national geography and source. Conflicting dashboard totals must be reconciled by the responsible authority, not averaged or silently selected.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and any legally competent quality-assurance or professional authority
higherEducation.authorityNotice: The official public-university description and official list of private establishments with Licence and Master offerings must be read at the exact institution, program, site, level, authorization and publication date. Inclusion of an institution does not authorize every program or prove accreditation. Legal status, program opening authorization, degree authority, quality evaluation, accreditation, professional recognition, site, modality and validity are distinct claims.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 establishing the Digital Code, Book V, as amended by Law No. 2020-35 of 6 January 2021
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 2015-08 of 8 December 2015 establishing the Child Code
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Controller and processor roles, prior formalities or the applicable DPO register, legal basis, transparency, purpose limitation, minimization, security, retention, learner rights, sensitive and biometric data, images, transfers, child participation, safeguarding, reporting and institutional authorization require qualified review under the current amended framework before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French and Benin's national languages have distinct official, literacy, curriculum, higher-education and community roles. Fon, Yoruba, Bariba, Dendi, Ditammari and other languages or varieties must not be collapsed into one generic national-language option. Preserve exact language, orthography, department or community, level, approved material, accessibility requirement and qualified community review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Beninese education reviewer is named.
MEMP, MESTFP, departmental, MESRS, institution and quality-assurance responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified unified school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record preserves subsector, official evidence, department, commune, status, source year and review date.
Conflicting dashboard statistics are reconciled by the responsible authority and every figure preserves extract date, academic year, definition, structure coverage, sector and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve ministry, subsector, level, class or trade, subject, language, validating text, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, exact program, level, authorization, quality decision, degree authority, site, modality and date or validity.
French and each national language are represented according to their distinct educational and community context.
Privacy, child-protection, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
